name: Shooting range medal counts
summary: How the guides count shooting range courses and gold medals, including figures that do not agree.
body: PowerPyx's range guide names six courses at each of the two ranges, 12 in all, with 18 gold medals at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch, 42 in total.
PowerPyx's hub page and progress database page instead say 14 shooting range challenges with 42 gold medals.
The same PowerPyx guide also gives totals of 54 medals for Griffin and 72 for Rodgers Ranch when bronze and silver are counted.
DayOne lists the same 12 course names, six per range.
PowerPyx says a $5 waiver pass from the clerk opens the challenges at each range and a missing weapon type can be rented for $10.

facts.location: Vice City; Port Gellhorn

name: Race challenges by name
summary: The 13 race challenges as PowerPyx names them, compared with the nine trials DayOne lists.
body: PowerPyx lists them in menu order: Ambrosia Raceway Trial, Hamlet BMX Stunt Run, Boone Speedway Trial, Gellhorn Raceway Trial, Gellhorn Dragway Trial, Kalaga Cycling Trial, Mud Club Air Time Stunt Run, Mud Club Drag Trial, Mud Club Hill Climb Trial, Mud Club Dirt Track Trial, Mud Club Oval Trial, Mud Club Swamp Run Trial and Waning Sands Motocross Stunt Run.

DayOne lists nine trials, each tracking a best time and a medal: Boone Speedway, Gellhorn Raceway, Kalaga Cycling and the six Mud Club events; it does not list the Ambrosia, Hamlet BMX, Gellhorn Dragway or Waning Sands events.
PowerPyx says each has bronze, silver and gold medals for beating a time or score, and that 10 gold medals count for the completion checklist.
Neither guide states the vehicle used or the medal thresholds for any of them.

facts.location: Ambrosia, Hamlet, Boone Speedway, Gellhorn, Kalaga, Thrillbilly Mud Club, Waning Sands

name: Tenebrae Lux
summary: Puzzle walking game on the home JoySystem console, one of the four playable video games.
body: PowerPyx says it is played from the controller at the TV in the player's home, is unavailable during the second chapter and returns from the third.
DayOne describes it as a walking simulator about solving puzzles on an island to reach a lighthouse, with 12 puzzles, 11 notebook pages, 33 credits and 20 shadow creature sightings tracked.
Press Start calls it a send-up of showpiece walking simulators that is nonetheless rather good.

facts.location: TV console at the player's home

name: Street Trash III
summary: Zombie shooter on the home JoySystem console, one of the four playable video games.
body: PowerPyx names it Street Trash III; DayOne calls it Street Trash 3: Dezombifier and Press Start writes Street Trash 3: DeZombifier.
PowerPyx says it is played at the home TV console, with the same second-chapter gap as the other home games.

DayOne describes runs through a zombie outbreak in which a character is built up each time, and lists tracked goals such as extracting after a 666 kill streak, a 666 Mode, 66 core cards and 6 obsidian cards.
Press Start describes it as an extraction shooter and the most rounded of the home console games.

facts.location: TV console at the player's home

name: Time Jackers Rewind
summary: Top-down twin-stick shooter on the home JoySystem console, one of the four playable video games.
body: PowerPyx names it Time Jackers Rewind; DayOne and Press Start write Time Jackers: Rewind.
DayOne describes a top-down, twin-stick, retro-future shooter with time powers, seven zones, and tracked goals such as finishing in under 20 minutes.
Press Start describes it as a slow-paced twin-stick shooter in a cyberpunk setting.
PowerPyx says it is played at the home TV console and cannot be played during the second chapter.

facts.location: TV console at the player's home

name: Bang For Your Buck
summary: Light-gun hunting arcade game found on cabinets out in the world, the only one of the four video games not on the home console.
body: PowerPyx says it is only on arcade machines, for example outside the Bargain World clothing store in Port Gellhorn.
Press Start says it is found in bars and venues, plays like a light-gun hunting cabinet with several stages and power-ups, and rewards shooting bucks while sparing does.
DayOne lists three stages, 15 cabinets with a top spot to take, and tracked kills by shotgun, rifle and minigun.
PowerPyx says starting each of the four games once is enough for the completion checklist, and finishing all levels of any one earns the Stick Fiddler trophy.

facts.location: Arcade machines in bars and venues; one outside Bargain World, Port Gellhorn

name: Golf rounds and records
summary: What the game tracks at each of the five golf venues, per DayOne, set beside PowerPyx's locations.
body: DayOne lists 9-hole and 18-hole games, best scores and holes in one for King Gator Adventure Golf and Frontier Adventure Golf.
DayOne lists a single full challenge, a best score and holes in one for Dino Golf Challenge, Leaf Links and Mount Hailes, plus a driving range record at Dino Golf Challenge and at Mount Hailes.
PowerPyx places King Gator in Buckskin Swamp, Frontier in Waning Sands, Dino Golf Challenge in Frogswater, Leaf Links in Vice Beach and Mount Hailes at the Mount Hailes Club in Waning Sands.
DayOne spells the Vice Beach course Leaf Link; PowerPyx writes Leaf Links.

facts.location: Buckskin Swamp; Waning Sands; Frogswater; Vice Beach

name: Pool opponents by venue
summary: The six pool opponents located so far and where each table sits, with the seventh still unfound on November 18, 2026.
body: PowerPyx places the tables as follows: Skeeter's on the south edge of Hamlet, table on the south side; Zotico's on the western edge of Balsero, table on the east side; The Thirsty Wolf on the north-west edge of Belville, table on the north side.

Also per PowerPyx: Jacob's Tavern on the east side of Millport beside the Pay 'n' Spray, table on the north side; Delights Cabaret in Port Gellhorn, table in the centre; Kowaachobee Cafe & Bar off the highway through Buckskin Swamp, table on the west side.
PowerPyx had not found the seventh opponent, and says there are 17 tables in all but only some have an opponent.
PowerPyx's pool guide files Skeeter's under Mariana County while placing it in Hamlet, which its race guide puts in Vice-Dale County.
DayOne says the game tracks tables played, opponents defeated, games won and games played with the partner.

facts.location: Hamlet; Balsero; Belville; Millport; Port Gellhorn; Buckskin Swamp

name: Basketball records
summary: What the game tracks for basketball, per DayOne, including an Eris Challenge checkbox.
body: DayOne lists hoops scored, jump shots, layups, longest scoring streak and shots among the tracked figures.
DayOne also lists a checkbox for an Eris Challenge and does not explain what it involves.
PowerPyx counts 100 hoops; no guide read lists where individual hoops are.
